data.one_liner: A customizable interactive bottom sheet that lets users interact with the screen behind it.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable interactive bottom sheet widget supporting snap points and adjustable draggable areas. It allows users to interact with the underlying screen while the sheet is present.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet that allows interaction with the background screen
You require customizable snap points and drag areas for a bottom sheet
avoid_when: You need standard modal bottom sheets that block background interaction entirely
strengths: Allows interaction with the screen behind the sheet
Offers customization options for colors, sizes, and draggable areas
weaknesses: Requires manual wrapping with a ScrollView for scrolling behavior
May require overriding the bottomSheetTheme for top border radius on iOS
